title: Chaz King. Eye-witness to the Vandenberg UAP speaks out.
description:
A conversation with Chaz King. 

Chaz's military career has taken him all around the world including multiple deployments on the global war on terror. During his time at Vandenberg he was an eye-witness to the now infamous red-square craft. 

We discuss his favourite and most unusual encounters and get into great detail over his sighting of the craft.

I am joined by my co-host Tom Vernon ‪@TomVernonUAP‬  
Chaz's X account : @Snazzy252525
